pricing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
pricing.faq.subtitle: Real questions people send us, answered honestly.
pricing.faq.gpl.q: What is GPLv3 and how does it affect me?
pricing.faq.gpl.a: TypeWhisper is open source under GPLv3. You may install and run the GPL version as-is, including for internal professional or commercial work, subject to the GPL. Premium features such as Sync Dictionary & Snippets and Learn from Corrections require a Commercial license. If you distribute, embed, rebrand, or ship TypeWhisper in a way that is not GPL-compatible, or if you need procurement, invoicing, or priority support, use a Commercial license.
pricing.faq.freelancer.q: I'm a freelancer – do I need a commercial license?
pricing.faq.freelancer.a: Not merely because you run the unmodified GPL app while working. Consider the Individual tier if you want Premium sync or learning from corrections, or if you need non-GPL terms, invoicing, procurement, priority support, or rights to redistribute/ship TypeWhisper in a proprietary context.
pricing.faq.workPay.q: I use it at work but pay for it myself – what tier?
pricing.faq.workPay.a: For ordinary internal use of the unmodified GPL app, you can stay on the GPL path. Use a Commercial tier if you want Premium sync or learning from corrections, or if your employer needs non-GPL terms, procurement, invoicing, support, or managed licensing.
pricing.faq.upgrade.q: Can I upgrade from Individual to Team later?
pricing.faq.upgrade.a: Yes. Write to licensing@typewhisper.com and we'll prorate the difference against your existing subscription or lifetime purchase.
pricing.faq.supporterVsCommercial.q: What's the difference between a Supporter tier and a Commercial license?
pricing.faq.supporterVsCommercial.a: Supporter tiers are a thank-you for individuals who want to fund the project. They do not grant alternative commercial license terms. If you need non-GPL terms, procurement, support, or proprietary redistribution/embedding rights, use a Commercial license.
pricing.faq.lifetimeUpdates.a: Yes. Lifetime covers all future TypeWhisper updates in the same product line.
pricing.faq.enterpriseLifetime.q: Is there a Lifetime option for Enterprise?
pricing.faq.enterpriseLifetime.a: No. Enterprise is a subscription, monthly or yearly, because it includes ongoing support: a reply within one business day, help with the rollout, and answers for security and privacy reviews. Lifetime remains available for Individual and Team. Enterprise Lifetime licenses bought earlier keep their device allowance and get the same Enterprise support, and existing Enterprise subscriptions keep their price.
pricing.faq.largeRollout.q: We need more than {enterpriseDevices} devices. What now?
pricing.faq.largeRollout.a: Enterprise covers up to {enterpriseDevices} devices. For a larger rollout, write to licensing@typewhisper.com and we'll put together an offer for your organization.
pricing.faq.cancel.q: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
pricing.faq.cancel.a: You keep commercial-license benefits until the end of your paid period. After that, the commercial license expires; you can still use the app under GPLv3, but non-GPL terms, procurement/support benefits, and managed commercial rights would require renewal.
pricing.faq.refund.a: Yes. Write to licensing@typewhisper.com within 14 days of purchase and we'll refund you, no questions asked.
pricing.faq.discounts.q: Do you offer educational or non-profit discounts?
pricing.faq.discounts.a: Non-profits and students, get in touch at licensing@typewhisper.com. We usually have headroom for fair discounts.
pricing.faq.activate.q: How do I activate my license?
pricing.faq.activate.a: Use the key you received after checkout. On the Mac, open Settings > License, paste the key, and activate it. On Windows, choose Premium in the sidebar, then License, paste the key, and activate it. On iPhone, iPad, and Android, open Settings > Premium, sign in, and connect your existing license.
